name: skill-prd
description: Skill de criacao e validacao de PRDs estruturados — 4 modos (Guided/Context Dump/Best Guess/From Brief), 3 niveis (Lean/Standard/Comprehensive), scorecard 5D, frameworks embutidos (MITRE/OST/Epic Hypothesis/MoSCoW/3 camadas), pipeline upstream (idea-to-brief, deep-research, NotebookLM), Deep Modules (Ousterhout), Testing Decisions com prior art, hygiene anti-rot, suporte a ADRs e domain glossary. Gera tasks vertical-slice (tracer bullets) com labels Direto/Bloqueante e rastreabilidade Parent.
